items.title: SIM card activation
items.computation: Date is printed explicitly in the letter as the activation date; also the anchor for the 12-month minimum term.

warnings: This is a contract summary (§ 54 TKG), not a bill or a request for action; no payment or response is due now — it only records the terms for later reference.

The minimum term runs 12 months from activation (16.06.2025); counting the day after activation under § 187/188 BGB gives a term end of 16.06.2026, one day later than a plain '12 months from 16.06.2025' reading — check the full T&Cs in the customer portal if this matters.

The 1-month notice period before that term end computes to Saturday 16.05.2026; German case law says notice deadlines don't shift to the next business day, so to be safe the cancellation should reach Muster Mobil GmbH by Friday 15.05.2026 at the latest.
The IBAN in the footer (DE08 3705 0198 0008 0011 22) is well-formed and matches the sender's own letterhead; it is only relevant if you owe money, which this letter does not claim.
